aboutUs.heading: About CITE Computer Institute
aboutUs.story: CITE Computer Institute was founded in 2011 with one goal: make quality, job-ready computer education accessible to every student in the city. What started as a single classroom with 12 students has grown into two full-fledged branches with modern labs, experienced faculty, and thousands of successful alumni working across the IT industry.
aboutUs.mission: To deliver practical, industry-relevant computer training that turns beginners into confident, employable professionals.
aboutUs.vision: To be the most trusted computer training institute in the region, known for outcomes, not just certificates.
